mapper.select: select r.code from user_role ur join role r on ur.roleId = r.roleId where ur.userId = #{userId} and r.status = 1
select distinct rp.permissionCode from user_role ur join role r on ur.roleId = r.roleId join role_permission rp on ur.roleId = rp.roleId where ur.userId = #{userId} and r.status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_role (userId, roleId, createTime) value (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{createTime})
